reserveReview.rationale: Re-review of the Accountable Noon dashboard payload at data timestamp 1790109063926 (2026-09-22T20:31:03.926Z; total reserves $40,086,693.58; verifiability 100%; reported collateralization 1.034388), captured while verifying Noon's 2026-09-23 listing feedback. Raw deployment values are Private Credit (Fasanara FTAC) $24,821,598.61, Funding Rate Arb (HYPE) $5,370,082.56, US Treasury Bills $3,960,515.97, Undeployed $2,179,938.83, CLOs (JAAA) $1,799,287.72, DeFi Lending (Morpho) $977,965.99, DeFi Lending (Euler) $977,302.87, and Funding Rate Arb (BTC) $1.02. The current Accountable adapter converts positive values to one decimal and lets the largest row absorb the rounding residual, which emits 62.0%, 13.4%, 9.9%, 5.4%, 4.5%, 2.4% and 2.4%; the BTC balance is 0.0000025% and is not emitted. The pinned 2026-08-29 composition is superseded: funding-rate arbitrage rose from 4.0% to 13.4% and the Undeployed bucket from 2.1% to 5.4%, while the tokenized Treasury-bill row fell from 21.5% to 9.9%. The same payload's reserves_split reconciles every deployment row to a named custodian to within a cent. Fasanara $24,821,598.61 equals the private-credit row; Alpaca $5,759,803.69 equals the Treasury-bill row plus the JAAA row; Ceffu $1.02 equals the Funding Rate Arb (BTC) dust; ForDefi $9,195,978.92 equals HYPE plus Euler plus Morpho plus a $1,870,627.50 residual; and that residual plus the Safe's $309,311.33 equals the Undeployed row exactly. The Undeployed bucket is therefore on-chain USDC/USDT under ForDefi MPC wallets and the 4-of-5 Noon Safe 0x365bd6fb4200e422a2b1f7b9Dfb1C00471E6D089, which matches the first reserve category in ToS Section 5, and it is classified as a stablecoin holding instead of the prior unclassified other. Its liquidity horizon stays conservative at seven days because the bucket does not reconcile with the two published collateral wallets: those held $3,048,146.55 of USDC and USDT at block 25,977,621 (2026-09-14T18:55:11Z) and $574,101.01 at block 26,036,288 (2026-09-22T23:24:47Z), a shortfall of about $1.62M against the Undeployed figure. The US Treasury Bills row is a tokenized position rather than direct bill ownership. Accountable's $3,960,515.97 equals, at par, the Dinari USD+ balance of Noon's EOA 0x4fD04553468610e5a88a2cffA38E057C954312Da in token 0xc9e3df3d230980b45adc623c81c3df4a73a5350f read at block 26,036,288. That token is permissioned and rebasing: balances grow through balancePerShare, a Dinari TransferRestrictor can freeze holders, its implementation 0xd5b7ca2a0b6c1f63b658b676e914f57f205cb520 is unverified in Sourcify and Etherscan, redemption runs through UsdPlusRedeemer.requestRedeem with fulfilment gated by FULFILLER_ROLE, and 99.68% of the token's supply sits in this one wallet. Three observed redemptions settled in USDC 27 to 33 hours after the burn (3,100,000 on 2026-09-01, 2,200,000 on 2026-09-02, 800,000 on 2026-09-08), against Noon's stated T+0 to T+3 bill liquidity. The row therefore moves from treasury-bill to tokenized-security with a Dinari obligor and a seven-day horizon, and it no longer claims sovereign issuer identity. Legacy risk tiers on every row still mirror the live Accountable adapter risk map so that live-versus-curated drift monitoring stays comparable; the structured slice fields carry the corrected view. Funding-rate arbitrage keeps the hedged-crypto classification supported by Noon's cash-and-carry documentation, but its collateral is attributed to the ForDefi bucket, which the dated split shows rather than the Ceffu mapping on the custody page. Morpho and Euler remain documented overcollateralized USDC/USDT lending strategies whose vault addresses, pool weights and borrowers are unpublished. FTAC and JAAA classifications otherwise carry over from the prior review.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Provider shares are pinned to the reserves_split in the Accountable payload of 2026-09-22T20:31:03.926Z and move with every deployment change, so they are a dated snapshot rather than a standing allocation. A 0% undisclosed share means every reserve dollar in that snapshot carries a named custodian of record; it does not mean the custody chain is documented end to end. Noon's custody page is about nine months old and assigns funding-rate-arbitrage collateral to Ceffu, while the dated split leaves Ceffu with $1.02 and places the entire $5,370,082.56 funding-rate book inside the ForDefi bucket. The ForDefi wallet set behind that bucket is unpublished, and its undeployed USDC/USDT residual does not reconcile with the two collateral wallets on Noon's transparency page. Fasanara both deploys and custodies the private-credit position, so no independent custodian stands behind 61.92% of reserves, and no sub-custodian, trust, or special-purpose vehicle is named anywhere. Alpaca's FINRA and SIPC membership and its excess Lloyd's of London cover are issuer claims from the custody page rather than verified documents, and Noon reaches Alpaca only through Dinari's permissioned USD+ token and the JAAA fund token. A second Dinari USD+ contract 0x98C6616F1CC0D3E938A16200830DD55663dd7DD3 holds 7,718,967.41 units and maps to no Accountable bucket. Segregation is contractual only: ToS Section 1 segregates the reserves from the Company's corporate operating funds, names no custodian, trust, or special-purpose vehicle, and ToS Section 6 makes a validly submitted redemption request an unsecured debt of the issuer, so holders have no bankruptcy-remote structure. Rehypothecation is conditional because ToS Section 5 authorizes redeployment only within a disclosed category list of stablecoin balances, tokenized and direct traditional-finance products, lending protocols, and delta-neutral funding-rate positions, rather than granting custodians open reuse rights.
